budget_categories_amounts_ck.name: budget_categories_amounts_ck
budget_categories_amounts_ck.value: ("budget_categories"."estimate_minor" IS NULL OR "budget_categories"."estimate_minor" >= 0) AND ("budget_categories"."forecast_minor" IS NULL OR "budget_categories"."forecast_minor" >= 0)

business_members_business_account_uq.name: business_members_business_account_uq
business_members_business_account_uq.where: "business_members"."account_id" is not null and "business_members"."removed_at" is null

listings_claimed_ck.name: listings_claimed_ck
listings_claimed_ck.value: ("listings"."claimed" and "listings"."business_id" is not null) or (not "listings"."claimed" and "listings"."business_id" is null)

spaces_dims_ck.name: spaces_dims_ck
spaces_dims_ck.value: ("spaces"."width_mm" is null or "spaces"."width_mm" > 0) and ("spaces"."length_mm" is null or "spaces"."length_mm" > 0)

plan_items_dims_ck.name: plan_items_dims_ck
plan_items_dims_ck.value: ("plan_items"."diameter_mm" is null or "plan_items"."diameter_mm" > 0) and ("plan_items"."width_mm" is null or "plan_items"."width_mm" > 0) and ("plan_items"."length_mm" is null or "plan_items"."length_mm" > 0) and ("plan_items"."seats" is null or "plan_items"."seats" >= 0)

catalogue_items_price_ck.name: catalogue_items_price_ck
catalogue_items_price_ck.value: ("catalogue_items"."price_per_stem_minor" is null or "catalogue_items"."price_per_stem_minor" > 0) and ("catalogue_items"."price_per_bunch_minor" is null or "catalogue_items"."price_per_bunch_minor" > 0)
